name: What pool remodeling mistakes are most common in older Los Angeles homes?

mainEntity.name: What pool remodeling mistakes are most common in older Los Angeles homes?
mainEntity.text: What pool remodeling mistakes are most common in older Los Angeles homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common mistakes in older Los Angeles pool remodels are starting with cosmetics before diagnosing underlying issues, underestimating hidden damage, and choosing materials without checking the shell condition. Another common error is ignoring drainage or deck movement, which can cause the new work to fail early. Price-only bidding is also risky. Older pools often need more prep, crack repair, waterproofing, or equipment updates than homeowners expect. If the contractor does not inspect carefully, the estimate may look low at first and then rise through change orders later. Access planning matters too, especially on older lots with narrow side yards, limited staging space, or tight equipment locations. Homeowners should ask for an inspection-based scope and a clear sequence of work. The safest remodels solve the structural and functional issues first, then finish the visible surfaces. That approach reduces rework and helps the remodel last longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common mistakes include skipping leak diagnosis, choosing finishes before checking the shell, underestimating hidden damage, ignoring drainage, and comparing bids by price only. Older Los Angeles homes also often need better access planning and more careful coordination of electrical, plumbing, and finish work.
